sections.heading: C2 — General Driving
sections.markdown:
## C2 — General Driving

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A67
Before passing, anticipate users moving into your space because of roadside people, cyclists, a narrow bridge, ice, damaged pavement or an obstruction. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A67
Begin passing only with known return space, without assuming several vehicles can be passed or that other drivers will make room. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A68
Complete a pass before reaching the start of a no-passing zone. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A68
Do not pass when the center line on your side is solid. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A68
A broken center line on your side permits passing only when no oncoming vehicles occupy the passing lane. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A68
A yellow No Passing Zone pennant on the left or a white Do Not Pass sign on the right prohibits passing there. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A68
When passing a cyclist, slow down and leave at least 3 feet between the vehicle’s right side and the bicycle. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A68
On school property, an undivided road or a Maine parking area, stop for a school bus displaying flashing red lights when approaching from either direction. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A68
After stopping for the described school bus, wait while children board or leave and proceed only when the bus moves or its driver signals permission. [A68]
Source: [A68 -> pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A69
On a divided road, stop for a school bus’s flashing red lights or extended stop arm unless a solid divider separates your roadway from the bus. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R11 | anchor: A69
In the divided-road bus guidance, proceed slowly while watching for children after the red lights stop and the stop arm is no longer visible. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R12 | anchor: A69
Park so the vehicle creates no hazard or interference with public-road traffic. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R13 | anchor: A69
Park parallel to the road unless painted angle-parking lines indicate otherwise. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R14 | anchor: A69
Leave at least 2 feet between your parked vehicle and vehicles ahead or behind. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R15 | anchor: A69
Use a marked parking area and move as far out of travel lanes as available shoulder space permits. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R16 | anchor: A69
Beside a curb, park as close as practical and no farther than 18 inches away. [A69]
Source: [A69 -> pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec07-R17 | anchor: A70
Secure a parked vehicle with its parking brake and park gear, or first or reverse gear for a manual transmission. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R18 | anchor: A70
For hill parking, arrange the wheels so an unintended roll is stopped by the curb, or without a curb moves off the road rather than into traffic. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R19 | anchor: A70
Exit on the curb side when possible; before opening a traffic-side door, look behind for vehicles and especially bicycles. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R20 | anchor: A70
When leaving the car, switch off the engine and remove the key, and lock it if it will be out of sight. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R21 | anchor: A70
Under the described municipal restrictions, reserved disability parking requires the appropriate permit or plates. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R22 | anchor: A70
The manual lists a $100 state-law fine for misuse of disability plates or placards. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R23 | anchor: A70
A municipality may prohibit parking in loading zones. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R24 | anchor: A70
The municipal examples prohibit parking within 10 feet of a hydrant where that ordinance applies. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R25 | anchor: A70
The municipal examples prohibit parking within 15 feet of a fire-station driveway or directly opposite its entrance. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R26 | anchor: A70
The municipal examples prohibit parking within 15 feet of a crosswalk. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R27 | anchor: A70
Municipal restrictions may reserve public-place entrances from parking during designated hours. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R28 | anchor: A70
Using a disability space with an access aisle requires displaying a disability plate or placard and using the aisle for vehicle entry or exit, such as with a lift or mobility device. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R29 | anchor: A70
Parking in an access aisle is prohibited, and misuse is a traffic infraction with a fine of at least $200. [A70]
Source: [A70 -> pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec07-R30 | anchor: A71
Check signs and painted curbs for parking prohibitions or limits. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-R31 | anchor: A71
To enter an angle or perpendicular space, check traffic, signal, center the vehicle and stop at the front of the space. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-R32 | anchor: A71
When leaving an angle or perpendicular space, keep checking traffic and reverse until the front bumper clears the neighboring vehicle. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-R33 | anchor: A71
After that clearance, steer toward the desired rearward direction, stop once clear of the space, select drive and move ahead. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-R34 | anchor: A71
For the described parallel-parking setup, check traffic and signal, then align beside the car ahead of the space about 2 feet away. [A71]
Source: [A71 -> pdf-0071]

FACT_ID: sec07-R35 | anchor: A72
In the parallel-parking method, select reverse only when clear, look rearward and turn right while backing slowly. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R36 | anchor: A72
In that method, straighten the wheels after the front door passes the forward car’s rear bumper, then continue backing straight. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R37 | anchor: A72
Once clear of the forward car, steer left while backing and stop before touching the rear vehicle. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R38 | anchor: A72
Steer right and pull forward to center the vehicle in the parallel space; straighten the wheels unless parked on a hill. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R39 | anchor: A72
After parallel parking, aim for about 6 inches from the curb and never exceed 18 inches. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R40 | anchor: A72
The described parking reference points may require adjustment for the vehicle’s size. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R41 | anchor: A72
To leave a parallel space, check traffic, brake and back near the rear vehicle, then signal, select drive and move forward slowly. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R42 | anchor: A72
Before steering out of a parallel space, confirm the front bumper clears the forward car; otherwise reverse and readjust. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R43 | anchor: A72
In the described parallel-space exit, move promptly into the lane once the doorpost clears the forward car’s rear bumper. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R44 | anchor: A72
From a right-side parking position, look over the left shoulder; from a left curb, look over the right shoulder before entering traffic. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R45 | anchor: A72
Signal and pull out slowly only when the destination lane is clear for a safe distance. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec07-R46 | anchor: A73
When going around the block is unavailable, a street, alley or driveway may serve for a two-point turnaround. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R47 | anchor: A73
For a reverse two-point turnaround, check behind, signal right and drive 1 car length beyond the driveway before looking over the right shoulder and backing into it. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R48 | anchor: A73
After backing into the driveway for that turnaround, select drive, check traffic and turn left into the proper lane only when clear, with a left signal. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R49 | anchor: A73
For a forward two-point turnaround, check oncoming traffic, signal left and turn into the drive or alley near its right side. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R50 | anchor: A73
In the forward method, stop once the rear clears the driveway edge, then check traffic, signal right and select reverse. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R51 | anchor: A73
When clear, back with a sharp right steer, straighten and stop centered in the lane, then select drive and cancel the signal. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R52 | anchor: A73
Use a three-point turnaround only on a two-lane road too narrow for a U-turn, preferring a trip around the block where possible. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R53 | anchor: A73
Begin the three-point method by checking mirrors, signaling right and stopping at the road’s right side. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R54 | anchor: A73
Next signal left, check traffic and the left blind spot, and when clear turn sharply left across the road and stop. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R55 | anchor: A73
Then select reverse, check traffic and both blind spots, and when clear steer sharply right while backing across and stop. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec07-R56 | anchor: A73
Finish by selecting drive, signaling left and checking traffic and blind spots before moving into the right lane in the new direction, then cancel the signal. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> pdf-0073]
